👮🙍 Police And Prisoner [2 Player Obby / 2 Player Prison Escape]

⚠️ This game is made for 2 players ⚠️

📊 Current Stage Count: 21 Stages

🚔 Escape from prison with your friend! One of you is a police officer 👮 and the other is a prisoner 🔒

🤝 Teamwork is key! Some stages are impossible to complete alone, so you and your friend must work together to make your way through the prison.

🤣 Can you escape without trolling your friend? Try to reach the end together... if you can! 😂

🎁 Like the game and join the group to get free items 🎁 -> [https://www.roblox.com/communities/887221955]

🤪 Troll your friend in the OBBY 🤣

💫 Like the game for awesome updates 👍🏼
